scope.basis: Steel from hydrogen direct reduced iron (captive renewable power, per Figure 2.9), compared with blast furnaces and with unabated natural gas-based DRI; the range runs across regions. Levelised cost of production in 2024 (the text's present tense, matching Figure 2.9, 'Levelised cost of production of selected materials by technology, 2024'), IEA analysis. Energy costs are regional end-user prices for industry including taxes and charges; no explicit financial support, though support embedded in cost components (such as fossil fuel subsidies) may be included (figure note).
